mainEntity.name: Can I just frame the wall myself if it looks simple?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are unsure whether a wall is load-bearing, whether cracking is structural, or whether a permit is required, bring in a professional before demolition begins. That is especially important if the wall is uneven, the doors are sticking, or you are combining framing work with a remodel or repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can only DIY if you are certain it is non-structural and code-compliant. If there is any doubt about load, movement, or permitting, have it checked before you start.
